description:
Swimming Pool Tiles 004 are mixed blue pool mosaic tiles, small squares in several shades of blue, shown in the product photo under water, where the blend gives the pool floor and walls a gentle rippled look.

## How they look
Instead of one flat colour, this multi blue mosaic mixes lighter and darker blues across the sheet. Under water the variation tends to move with the light, so the lining looks natural and less uniform than a single shade, and small marks are less noticeable.

## Where they work
- **Full pool linings** where you want depth without going very dark.
- **Underwater pool tiles** on floors and walls that are seen mostly through the water.
- **Spa pools, plunge pools and fountains**, where a blue blend pool tile adds interest to a small surface.

A blend is also forgiving at repair time, since a replacement piece in a mixed field is harder to spot than in a plain colour.

## Good to know
- Category: swimming pool tiles
- Look: mixed blue square mosaic (from an underwater photo)
- Size, thickness and finish are not listed online yet; confirm them with your quote.

Mix pieces from several boxes as you lay them so no patch ends up all light or all dark, and ask your contractor about a pool-grade adhesive and grout for a wet, treated area.

## See it before you order
Visit the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) or G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715), wet the sample to see how the blend changes, and send your pool size and city for a dated quote. Compare it with [turquoise tiles 001](/products/swimming-pool-tiles-001) in the full [swimming pool tiles range](/categories/swimming-pool-tiles).

faqs.q: What is the price of mixed blue pool mosaic tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the pattern, the area to cover and delivery, so send your pool measurements and city on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Why choose a blue blend instead of one colour?
faqs.a: A blend of shades tends to look more natural under water, hides small marks and makes later repairs less visible. A single colour gives a cleaner, more uniform look.

faqs.q: Can mosaic tiles be used on the pool floor?
faqs.a: Yes. Mosaic is commonly used on pool floors and walls. The many grout lines tend to give bare feet more grip than one large glossy tile, and small pieces follow slopes well.

faqs.q: How do I get a sample?
faqs.a: Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with the product name and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
